executive_summary: Your AMBER status is driven entirely by supplier and peer concentration risk, not macroeconomic deterioration. Prioritize the China cluster for immediate contingency activation (dual sourcing, inventory buffer) since it touches your highest-exposure categories (EMS, batteries) and sits at the intersection of multiple trade-war vectors; the regional risks are real but more slowly evolving. Texas Instruments' stock dip is a secondary watch—flag it if it accelerates, but it lacks the geographic concentration risk of your China suppliers.
